records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.translocation_gene_scores#0
records.source: Per-gene translocation scores against non-targeting cells, with FDR.
records.translation: Puntuaciones de translocación por gen frente a células no dirigidas, con FDR.

records.context: The gene score of Feldman et al. (2019) for a per-cell translocation readout such as the nuclear DNA-marker correlation. For each guide with at least ``min_cells`` cells, the score is the integrated difference between the cumulative distribution of the non-targeting cells and that of the guide cells, negative when the guide lowers the readout (a translocation defect). The sign is fixed: a NEGATIVE score always means a translocation defect and a positive one a gain, whatever way the integral is written elsewhere. A gene scores the mean of its guides. Its P value comes from relabelling the cells of all its guides jointly with the non-targeting cells, and is two-sided with resolution ``1 / (permutations + 1)``. Mann-Whitney P values of all the cells of the gene against the non-targeting cells are reported beside it. Both P values are corrected across the genes of each group.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.translocation_gene_scores#1
records.source: The gene score of Feldman et al. (2019) for a per-cell translocation readout such as the nuclear DNA-marker correlation. For each guide with at least ``min_cells`` cells, the score is the integrated difference between the cumulative distribution of the non-targeting cells and that of the guide cells, negative when the guide lowers the readout (a translocation defect). The sign is fixed: a NEGATIVE score always means a translocation defect and a positive one a gain, whatever way the integral is written elsewhere. A gene scores the mean of its guides. Its P value comes from relabelling the cells of all its guides jointly with the non-targeting cells, and is two-sided with resolution ``1 / (permutations + 1)``. Mann-Whitney P values of all the cells of the gene against the non-targeting cells are reported beside it. Both P values are corrected across the genes of each group.
records.translation: La puntuación génica de Feldman et al. (2019) para una lectura de translocación por célula, como la correlación con el marcador nuclear de DNA. Para cada guía con al menos ``min_cells`` células, la puntuación es la diferencia integrada entre la distribución acumulada de las células no dirigidas y la de las células de la guía, negativa cuando la guía reduce la lectura (un defecto de translocación). El signo es fijo: una puntuación NEGATIVA siempre significa un defecto de translocación y una positiva, una ganancia, se escriba como se escriba la integral en otros lugares. Un gen recibe la media de sus guías. Su valor P se obtiene reetiquetando conjuntamente las células de todas sus guías con las células no dirigidas, y es bilateral con una resolución de ``1 / (permutations + 1)``. A su lado se informan los valores P de Mann-Whitney de todas las células del gen frente a las células no dirigidas. Ambos valores P se corrigen entre los genes de cada grupo.
